blocks.html: Another milestone unlocked for RLC Residences this 2021, as it officially launched to the public the newly-built SYNC Sales Hub last June 25.

Leading the ribbon-cutting ceremony and officially opening the Sales Hub are Head of Raise Sales Channel Ms. Cecille M. Mozo, Senior Director for Business Development Department Engr. Edgardo Samson, Associate Marketing Director Ms. Kristynne B. Tan, and SYNC Project/Site Architect, Arch. Roquelle Joy Egagamao-Batocabe.

Located along C-5 Bagong Ilog, Pasig City, the SYNC Sales Hub details everything you need to see and know about the property, including a scale model and project informational features to give future SYNC residents an overview of the development and what it has in store for them.

With its strategic location, SYNC offers a haven for urban professionals looking for a home that can cater to their on-the-go lifestyle. SYNC provides convenient, less than 10-kilometer access to nearby central business districts such as Ortigas, Bonifacio Global City, Makati, and the emerging Bridgetowne township. It also boasts health and leisure amenities, ranging from the stunning rooftop jog trail and fitness center to the game room, private theater, and leisure pool.

Schedule your visit at the SYNC Sales Hub via our Online Appointment Link, which you may type in to your browsers (bit.ly/RLCResidences_OnlineAppointment) or by connecting with our Property Specialist.
